amends: configs/scout_count_days_v1.json (declared 06:12 UTC, accepted by its governing run, docs/scout/count_days_results_v1.json)
declared_by: as v1: declaring and the governing run are research; building and any upload stay the user's word
status: DECLARED after v1's governing run and before v2's (tools/scout_count_days.py --score --declaration configs/scout_count_days_v2.json). v1's development results were known; the amendment is motivated by the ranking side only (below), not by a development reading, and changes no threshold.

why.overconfidence: v1 weighs the heavy candidates by v48's day model, whose noise and day-shift scale come from the 2025 development months. In LIRF July 2026 (no ADS-B coverage) the month's day residuals (published delay total minus the values' implied total) are far wider and heavy-tailed, so v1's 0.99 for the 5 July row is overconfident; against the month's own residuals the two candidates are about 2:1
why.one_row_moved: v1 moves a big candidate only when the posterior crosses midnight: on 5 July it moves one of the two candidates fully and leaves the other at its value, although the counts make v55 wrong on one of the two in either case. Posterior means on both rows beat v55 under either truth for a posterior around 0.65 (expected squared error p(1-p) x 2.75e9 against v55's p x 5.8e8 + (1-p) x 2.2e9); moving one row alone costs about 3.8 s if the other row is the one

procedure.as_v1: everything in configs/scout_count_days_v1.json procedure, except the two options below
procedure.density_empirical: for a complete day with heavy candidates placed on it: the Gaussian kernel density (Silverman's bandwidth, at least 1 s) of the airport-month's day residuals r_d = published delay total - sum of max(a - value, 0) over the in-figure rows of the values' day d, over the month's other complete days (at least 5), evaluated at the day's residual with the heavy candidates placed as the state says (their expected positive delay on the side they take); label-free
procedure.big_rule_implicated: a big candidate of a flagged midnight takes the change of its posterior mean whenever the posterior probability of the side opposite its value's day is higher than its prior (the counts point at it); otherwise it keeps its value. Light candidates as in v1
procedure.code: src/prc2026_scout/count_days.py solve_month(density='empirical', big_rule='implicated'); v1 = the defaults ('model', 'cross'), reproduced byte for byte on v55 (SHA-256 7be7f3e1...) after the change

rule: as configs/scout_count_days_v1.json rule, unchanged: (1) no development month worse than v48's procedure by more than 0.005% of its RMSE; (2) the four months' total squared error not up; (3) crossings at least two thirds right (all, below 5); (4) confident candidates (>= 0.9) at least 85% right if at least 10

prior_exploration_disclosed.v1: all of configs/scout_count_days_v1.json prior_exploration_disclosed; v1 governing run: January -0.0008%, July -0.0057%, November -0.0218%, December -0.0449%, calibration 99.6% right at >= 0.99 (236), crossings 41/46, no big crossing in 2025; v1 dry run on v55 7be7f3e1..., 173 rows, S 7.96e8
